name: Takayanagi Utano
source:
Mother of his wife Remi. She married young and divorced. She raised Reimi while running a small snack bar. She has had enough of marriage and lives an uninhibited life. Currently, she has closed her restaurant to help raise her grandchildren.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_199.html]official site[/url]]
